# National Weather Service (weather.gov)

> > Official weather forecasts, warnings, and meteorological data from NOAA's National Weather Service

Weather.gov is the primary digital platform of the National Weather Service (NWS), operated by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). The site provides graphical forecast maps, regional weather information, and data distribution services covering CONUS, Puerto Rico, Guam, and other U.S. territories.

## Key Topics

- National Weather Service
- NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration)
- Graphical forecasts and weather maps
- Regional forecasts (CONUS, Puerto Rico, Guam)
- Weather-Ready Nation initiative
- Forecast visualization tools
- Meteorological data distribution
- WMO Regional Association services
- U.S. weather regions (Great Lakes, Plains, Rockies, Northeast, Mid Atlantic)
- Interactive weather mapping
- GTS (Global Telecommunication System)
- Ocean weather data
- GIFS (Global Internet File Service)
- Real-time weather information

## Graphical Forecasts & Interactive Maps

- [NOAA's National Weather Service - Graphical Forecast](https://graphical.weather.gov/): Interactive graphical weather forecast maps for CONUS and Puerto Rico
- [National Weather Service - Graphical Forecast](https://digital-x.weather.gov/): NWS graphical forecast interface with Weather-Ready Nation resources

## Data Distribution & File Services

- [RA4-GIFS: Home](https://ra4-gifs.weather.gov/): Global Internet File Service for WMO RA4 meteorological data exchange
- [Index of /](https://ftp.ocean.weather.gov/): FTP directory index for NWS ocean weather data repository
